svg.title: Iteration 2 — Partial Design Class Diagram (implemented scheduling PoC)

g.text: Iteration 2 — Partial Design Class Diagram (implemented scheduling PoC)
~reserve(patient, service, slot, location, channel, referralId) : Appointment
Records reference other records by identifiers, not mutable object ownership.
Fields shown are conceptual essentials, not every Java record component.
Clinical workflow, waitlists, resources, auth and audit are design-only.
